title: The relationship of learning traits, motivation and performance-learning response dynamics
reason: Fits a 'learning response dynamics' curve to aggregate chapter reading time from distance-course logs. The only outcome check compares model-predicted with post-test class-average ability (two values, no statistic); no per-student indicator is analysed.

extraction.design: model development with non-linear curve fitting of log data
extraction.population: web-based distance-class learners over two years (number not stated)
extraction.lms_indicators: daily reading time per chapter, login counts from asynchronous learning server logs
extraction.outcome_or_construct: model-derived learning speed/energy; class-average post-test ability
extraction.notes: Section 8.1: predicted average post-learning ability 0.6978 vs post-test 0.6981 (all learners, Chapter 6); 0.7963 vs 0.794791 (leading group, 19 learners). Group-average agreement only, so NOREL under the per-student include rule; adjudicator may reconsider.
